snippet.title: Gangs of Asia – Official Publishing Announcement
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce that MicroProse is partnering with MoonPunch to publish Gangs of Asia — a high-octane fusion of strategic gameplay and 1v1 Kung Fu combat.

Build your gang from powerful Sumos, stealthy Ninjas, and legendary Kung Fu Masters. Fight for control of the map, upgrade your forces, and unleash devastating special attacks in fast-paced, skill-driven battles.

Whether you’re teaming up in couch co-op, taking on rivals in PvP, or playing solo, Gangs of Asia delivers non-stop action — with a custom map editor coming soon.

Add it to your Steam wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2382670/Gangs_Of_Asia/
